clips.name: ylB
clips.description: Native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard mainland Putonghua accent. An elderly man in his late sixties with a warm, mellow, smiling voice, a kindly grandfather telling stories by the fire: medium-low pitch, rounded and soft, a little breathy with age, unhurried and gentle, full of real tenderness; when he is excited he brightens and chuckles. Very clear diction. Perfect studio audio quality.
